svg.title: Full system architecture
svg.desc: Three-layer architecture: trigger layer (Telegram bot, cron, dashboard), agent graph (research, analysis, HITL, publish), and infrastructure (Railway, SQLite, GitHub Actions)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the Telegram bot trigger commands')
sendPrompt('How does the cron schedule work?')
sendPrompt('What does the web dashboard UI show?')
sendPrompt('How does the research agent scrape sources?')
sendPrompt('How does the analysis quality loop work?')
sendPrompt('How does the HITL Telegram approval work?')
sendPrompt('How does the publisher post to X and Instagram?')
sendPrompt('How are images fetched and stored?')
sendPrompt('What gets stored in the SQLite run log?')
sendPrompt('How do I deploy to Railway for free?')
sendPrompt('How do I use GitHub Actions for the cron?')
sendPrompt('How do I deploy the React frontend for free?')
sendPrompt('How does the Telegram webhook work on Railway?')

svg.text: Purple = agent nodes · Teal = entry points · Amber = outputs · Gray = infra · Blue = deploy targets
